name: Virefane
description: Virefane hangs along the inner arm, a compact court of worlds bound to a supergiant heart. Its worlds formed late from enriched debris, and their crusts still carry the ratio of that violent birth. A standing bounty covers any intact core sample from the second planet outward.

stars.name: Kind Signal
stars.description: A supergiant of 8.74 solar masses, short-lived against the dark. A bloated giant whose photosphere could swallow the inner orbits whole. Ephemeris updates track its slow variability across the decades.

planets.name: Calmspire
planets.description: Banded clouds race around a deep crushing interior of metallic hydrogen. Storm ovals larger than worlds spin for centuries without fading. Claim jumpers whisper about a world that charts itself differently every survey.

moons.name: Bitter Scree I
moons.description: A battered companion keeping patient orbit through the ages. Tidal stress warms its interior, and frost cracks map the strain. Outgassing vents frost the trailing face a little more each orbit.

planets.name: Palevast
planets.description: Cracked highlands sprawl beneath a thin sky, every crater a kept record. Dust devils wander the basins, and the night side glitters with ice. The guild maintains a listening post here, though no report has ever named its purpose.

moons.name: Iron Flint V
moons.description: A battered companion keeping patient orbit through the ages. Its surface records every era of bombardment the system ever knew. Outgassing vents frost the trailing face a little more each orbit.

planets.name: Calmwold
planets.description: Lava lakes breathe through a fractured crust, resurfacing yearly. The air itself is a hazard the suits filter with complaint. Pilots time their burns to the pulsar remnant next door, when the static clears.

planets.name: Quartzwold
planets.description: A world-spanning sea hides all but a scatter of basalt teeth. Storms the size of continents roll unbroken around the equator. A derelict relay drifts at the edge, still warm, still broadcasting nothing.

planets.name: Rustmere
planets.description: A world-spanning sea hides all but a scatter of basalt teeth. Bioluminescent tides mark the shallows where the water runs warm. One moon occults on a schedule that matches no ephemeris, and navigators plan around it.

dwarfPlanets.name: Tide Lesser 51
dwarfPlanets.description: A small cold world holding its round shape against the dark. Frost plains stretch unbroken to a horizon that curves too soon. Its thin story is written entirely in impact craters.

belts.name: Moss Belt
belts.description: Countless fragments grind slowly against each other in a broad torus. Collisional dust hazes the lane, and larger bodies keep eccentric courts. Old mining claims dot the denser knots, most of them long expired.

comets.name: Silent Shroud
comets.description: A dirty snowball falling sunward on its long appointed round. Each passage sheds glittering debris the scopes track for seasons. Its tail leans away from the star like a banner in a gale.
